name: pilotage
description: The pilot office's own team, inside their own walls. To the quay office this whole file is one wrapper (the pilotage node of their network file): their triage clerk, their chart lookup run by the chart room on a third engine, and their boarding team, whose answer crosses the boundary back. The quay office never sees inside: the wrapper answers, the office keeps its inside and its accounting.

neurons.description: The pilot office's triage clerk: takes the ask, marks it theirs.
The chart room, on its own engine: the pilot office's own supplier, reached through the pilot office's own peers file.
The boarding team: the slow part of the pilotage, and the exit the quay office sees. Their answer becomes our harbourmaster's ask.
